parks.name: NorthResidentialGarden
parks.role: Small garden: two entrances meet the existing fountain plaza; lawn remains open.

parks.name: CentralFountainGarden
parks.role: L-shaped garden approach between the existing buildings, with two sidewalk connections.

parks.name: CivicFountainGarden
parks.role: Three short approaches around the existing civic fountain, retaining a broad lawn.

parks.name: RiversideNorthMeadow
parks.role: Open meadow with a bend and east entrance; avoids the west river bank.

parks.name: RiversideBendGarden
parks.role: River bend walk linking the existing north footbridge and east sidewalk.

parks.name: RiversideWestPavilionWalk
parks.role: Long west bank promenade with pavilion access and two existing footbridge connections.

parks.name: RiversideEastPavilionWalk
parks.role: Narrow east bank walk with pavilion and south footbridge access; no water crossing.
